_about: Per-path page heads. Source of truth for middleware.js (heads served to crawlers that do not run JS) and for TAB_SEO in index.html. Edit tabs here, then run: python3 scripts/build_seo.py (rewrites TAB_SEO in index.html and refills countries/commodities). Descriptions: 155 characters at most, no live numbers.

default.alt: FoodShield AI: global food-security risk dashboard

elnino.alt: FoodShield El Niño Ocean map: sea-surface temperature and rain against normal over the last 7 days, from NOAA OISST and CPC gauges

global.title: FoodShield AI: Global Food Disruption Risk
global.description: How exposed each country's food supply is to trade, climate and conflict shocks, for 193 countries and 50 US states, every figure sourced and dated.

elnino.title: El Niño 2026 and the food supply · FoodShield AI
elnino.description: The 2026-27 El Niño traced from the Pacific to harvests, shipping lanes and food prices, from NOAA, BoM and FAO data, observed and modelled kept apart.

ensoharvest.title: El Niño and harvests: crops at risk · FoodShield AI
ensoharvest.description: Which harvests past El Niños hit hardest, fitted on FAOSTAT yields since 1961, with the tonnes at stake and the countries that would need to import more.

ensowater.title: El Niño and shipping: Panama, rivers, ports · FoodShield AI
ensowater.description: Panama Canal water levels, chokepoint transits from IMF PortWatch, river gauges and grain port loadings, set against the 2023-24 El Niño.

ensomoney.title: El Niño and food prices · FoodShield AI
ensomoney.description: Staple food prices in countries El Niño has hit before, from FAO GIEWS and the World Bank, beside the price paths of past El Niños.

ensolive.title: El Niño impacts reported now · FoodShield AI
ensolive.description: Floods, droughts and export decisions reported during the 2026-27 El Niño, from GDACS, ReliefWeb and agency bulletins, mapped by country.

ensomech.title: How El Niño works · FoodShield AI
ensomech.description: How El Niño works across the Pacific: trade winds, the Walker circulation, the warm pool and upwelling, each step shown with this week's readings.

country.title: Country food-security reports · FoodShield AI
country.description: Trade dependency, climate exposure, governance and conflict indicators for 193 countries and 50 US states, each figure with its source and date.

commodities.title: Staple crops: who depends on whom · FoodShield AI
commodities.description: Producers, importers and supplier concentration for staple crops, from FAOSTAT bilateral trade and USDA supply data.

disturbances.title: Live food-supply disturbances · FoodShield AI
disturbances.description: Hazards, conflict and export restrictions that touch food supply, from GDACS, ReliefWeb and HDX, refreshed every six hours.

scenario.title: Food-supply stress test · FoodShield AI
scenario.description: Close a chokepoint, add a heatwave, a drought, a port outage, a rate shock or sanctions, and see which constraint breaks first for a country.

forecast.title: 2030 structural outlook, not a forecast · FoodShield AI
forecast.description: Where import pressure builds by 2030 if population and food-output trends hold: today's structural score rescored, not a prediction.

score.title: Rankings: every country by food disruption risk · FoodShield AI
score.description: All 193 countries ranked by the Food Disruption Risk Score, with the components and the formula behind each score.

compare.title: Compare countries' food-supply risk · FoodShield AI
compare.description: Pin up to four countries to see their risk scores, score components and sourced indicators side by side.

news.title: Commodity Wire: food trade headlines · FoodShield AI

companies.title: Where food and fertilizer companies source · FoodShield AI
companies.description: Sourcing countries of major grain traders and fertilizer producers, taken from each company's own annual reports and filings, with citations.

livedata.title: Food price benchmarks: FAO and World Bank · FoodShield AI

datastatus.title: Data status: every source and its last refresh · FoodShield AI
datastatus.description: Every public data pipeline behind FoodShield: what it provides, when it last refreshed and whether it is healthy now, read from the source manifest.

about.title: About FoodShield AI
about.description: Which countries run short of food first when a shock hits, and why: what FoodShield measures, who built it, and the public data behind it.

methodology.description: How the Food Disruption Risk Score is built, weighted and checked, which public sources feed it, and what it does not measure.
